## Big idea

**Interceptors** are Spring MVC hooks around controller methods (after DispatcherServlet mapping).

```text
Filter (servlet) → DispatcherServlet → Interceptor.preHandle
                                      → Controller
                                      → Interceptor.postHandle
                                      → Interceptor.afterCompletion
```

## Example

```java
public class TimingInterceptor implements HandlerInterceptor {
    @Override
    public boolean preHandle(HttpServletRequest req, HttpServletResponse res, Object handler) {
        req.setAttribute("start", System.currentTimeMillis());
        return true; // false = stop
    }

    @Override
    public void afterCompletion(HttpServletRequest req, HttpServletResponse res,
                                Object handler, Exception ex) {
        Long start = (Long) req.getAttribute("start");
        System.out.println("took " + (System.currentTimeMillis() - start) + "ms");
    }
}
```

Register with `WebMvcConfigurer.addInterceptors`.

## Filter vs interceptor

| | Filter | Interceptor |
|--|--------|-------------|
| Level | Servlet | Spring MVC |
| Sees | All servlet requests | Mapped handler calls |
| Use | Auth wrappers, encoding | Handler-specific logic |

## Practice

1. Add timing interceptor.
2. Restrict it to `/api/**`.
3. Return `false` from `preHandle` for a path prefix and observe block.
